articles.title: Trump FCC faces blowback in attempt to police speech on broadcast TV
articles.text:
Conservatives and liberals lined up in opposition to the Federal Communications Commission’s attempt to punish ABC for speech that President Trump dislikes.
Liberal advocacy groups urged FCC Chairman Brendan Carr to end his attacks on ABC, and conservative groups warned Carr not to set a precedent that would harm conservatives in future administrations. Former FCC chairs and commissioners from prior Republican and Democratic administrations also joined in opposition to what they call Carr’s “campaign to censor disfavored speech and advance the president’s personal interest.”
The FCC recently ordered ABC to file early license-renewal applications for the eight TV stations it owns and operates. A petition to deny ABC’s license renewals was then submitted by the Center for American Rights, a conservative group whose previous petitions factored heavily into Carr’s “news distortion” investigations into broadcasters accused of bias against Republicans and Trump. Another petition to deny was filed by the conservative Media Research Center.
There was a July 29 deadline for people to submit oppositions to the petitions to deny ABC’s license renewals, and there is an August 5 deadline for replies to the opposition filings.
“Through this proceeding, the FCC seeks to censor Disney’s and ABC’s speech and send a chilling message to all broadcasters: carry speech we don’t like at your peril,” said a filing submitted by former Republican and Democratic FCC chairs and commissioners from the Reagan, George H.W. Bush, Clinton, and Obama eras.
Although the Trump FCC says the proceeding is over ABC’s potential violation of anti-discrimination rules with diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) practices, it was statements by Jimmy Kimmel that seemed to spur Carr into action on Trump’s behalf. In September 2025, Carr threatened to revoke ABC station licenses for “news distortion” if they continued airing Kimmel’s show. In April of this year, Carr ordered the highly unusual ABC license review one day after Trump and the first lady called for Kimmel to be fired over a joke in which he said Melania Trump looked like an “expectant widow.”

articles.title: Como recuperar fotos e vídeos de uma unidade externa (as melhores soluções) • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Você tem um HD externo, um SSD externo, um pendrive ou até um cartão de memória. Um dia, você descobre que as fotos e vídeos que você guardava na unidade sumiram ou foram apagados por engano. Acontece. Mas não se preocupe: com o método ou a ferramenta certa, você pode recuperar arquivos corrompidos ou deletados sem muito esforço.
É importante saber como recuperar fotos, vídeos e outros arquivos de unidades externas porque há várias situações que podem causar perda de dados. Alguns exemplos:
- queda de energia, que interrompe operações de gravação de dados na unidade, corrompendo os dados;
- falha na criação de partições no SSD ou HD externo;
- ação de vírus ou outros malwares;
- arquivos deletados por engano (você excluiu os dados errados);
- formatação equivocada (você escolheu a unidade errada para formatar);
- falhas no sistema de arquivos causadas por operações inesperadas no computador;
- unidade removida do computador antes de uma transferência de dados ser concluída.
Não importa a causa: há solução. A restauração de dados perdidos ou excluídos em unidades externas será explicada a seguir, com instruções passo a passo.
Acesse a Lixeira ou o Lixo do computador
Pode acontecer de você ter selecionado fotos ou vídeos presentes na unidade de armazenamento externo e apertado, sem querer, a tecla Delete ou um botão de excluir arquivos. Por isso, o primeiro passo de recuperação consiste em acessar a Lixeira / Lixo do seu PC ou Mac.
Veja se há arquivos na Lixeira do Windows
Na Área de Trabalho, simplesmente abra a Lixeira do Windows. Os arquivos que sumiram da unidade externa estão lá? Ótimo!
Selecione-os com o botão direito do mouse e escolha “Restaurar” para que eles retornem à unidade.
Veja se as fotos ou vídeos estão no Lixo do Mac
Já se você estiver no macOS, clique no ícone do Lixo, no Dock. Veja se as fotos ou vídeos perdidos foram parar lá. Se positivo, selecione os arquivos a serem recuperados, novamente com o botão direito do mouse, e escolha “Colocar de Volta” ou equivalente.
Verifique se os arquivos estão ocultos
Também pode acontecer de fotos ou vídeos continuarem guardados na unidade externa, mas ficarem ocultos ali por algum motivo, como a ação de um vírus ou uma configuração equivocada de um editor de imagens.
Verificando arquivos ocultos no Windows
No sistema operacional da Microsoft, abra o HD ou o SSD externo e vá em “Explorador de Arquivos” / “Exibir” / “Mostrar” e marque a opção “Itens Ocultos”. Se houver arquivos ocultados na unidade, eles ficarão visíveis agora.
Você também pode usar o comando attrib no Prompt de Comando. Suponha que a unidade externa tenha sido identificada como E:\ em seu PC. Faça, então, o seguinte:
- digite “CMD” no campo de busca da Barra de Tarefas ou do Menu Iniciar para abrir o Prompt de Comando;
- no Prompt de Comando, digite attrib -h -s “E:\*.*” /s /d
Essa instrução faz todos os arquivos que estiverem ocultos ali serem revelados.
Checando arquivos ocultos no Mac
Se você estiver no macOS, siga estas etapas:
- abra o Finder e vá à unidade externa;
- pressione as teclas Command (⌘) + Shift + . (ponto).
Arquivos ocultos, se existirem, serão exibidos imediatamente.
Tente opções de restaurar versões anteriores
Às vezes, o arquivo foi apagado, mas é possível restaurá-lo por meio de cópias de segurança, se funções de backup estiverem ativas no sistema.
Como restaurar versões de arquivos no Windows
Tanto se você tiver no Windows 11 quanto no Windows 10, abra o Explorador de Arquivos, clique com o botão direito do mouse sobre o ícone da unidade externa e selecione “Restaurar Versões Anteriores”.
Se houver cópias, elas aparecerão em uma nova janela. Ali, clique em “Restaurar”.
Como restaurar versões de arquivos no Mac
No macOS, acesse a unidade externa por meio do Finder e clique no ícone da função Time Machine nos menus. Escolha “Entrar no Time Machine” ou equivalente e use a linha do tempo para recuperar versões de arquivos, se houver cópias, e finalize clicando em “Restaurar”.
Método definitivo: recupere fotos ou vídeos com o EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard
Se você constatar que as suas fotos ou vídeos realmente sumiram da sua unidade externa, é hora de partir para uma solução profissional de recuperação de arquivos. O EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard é um recuperador de dados que se destaca nessa tarefa por ter altos níveis de eficácia, segurança e desempenho.
Para você ter ideia, a ferramenta consegue restaurar dados até de HDs ou SSDs que foram formatados ou têm dados corrompidos por causa de uma falha no sistema de arquivos, por exemplo.
Como se não bastasse, o EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard é de fácil utilização, tem versões para Windows e Mac, e oferece até prévias de fotos ou vídeos que podem ser recuperados para que você selecione apenas o conteúdo que, de fato, deve ser restaurado.
Alerta
Antes de continuar, não salve, altere ou apague arquivos na unidade externa a ser analisada para evitar que essa operação sobrescreva os dados anteriores, impedindo a sua recuperação.
Como usar o EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard?
O procedimento é realmente fácil. Confira o passo a passo:
1 – baixe o EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard em seu PC com Windows ou no Mac; faça a instalação no SSD ou HD do próprio computador, e não na unidade externa;
2 – abra a ferramenta e, na coluna à esquerda, selecione a categoria de dispositivo a ser recuperado (discos, cartões SD, SSDs etc.); na área da direita, selecione a unidade externa que tem fotos ou vídeos a serem restaurados;
3 – feita a seleção, clique no botão de recuperação e aguarde a conclusão do procedimento;
4 – vá à pasta indicada para acessar os arquivos recuperados; se houver muitos deles, você pode selecionar a categoria dos arquivos (como vídeos, imagens e documentos) a serem recuperados no topo direito do EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard.
Há como evitar perda de arquivos em unidades externas?
Há, sim. Basta seguir alguns cuidados simples, como:
- antes de iniciar a recuperação: como já dito, evite salvar ou modificar arquivos em seu HD ou SSD externo, pois novas operações de escrita podem diminuir as chances de o procedimento funcionar;
- remova com segurança: sempre remova a unidade externa de seu PC ou Mac usando a função de ejetar do sistema operacional;
- finalize a transferência de dados: antes de desconectar a unidade, verifique se não há arquivos sendo transferidos ou salvos nela;
- cuidado com quedas ou superaquecimento: transporte o SSD ou HD externo com cuidado para evitar quedas, bem como o guarde longe de fontes de calor para prevenir danos;
- atenção com malwares: tome cuidado com links, sites e aplicativos duvidosos, pois eles podem conter vírus e outras ameaças que apagam arquivos.
Perguntas frequentes (FAQ)
O EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard funciona com HD ou SSD interno?
Sim. O EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard é compatível com uma grande diversidade de dispositivos, como discos rígidos e SSDs internos ou externos, pendrives, cartões de memória, câmeras digitais, players de música, entre outros.
É possível recuperar outros tipos de arquivos além de fotos e vídeos?
Com certeza! O EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard suporta mais de 1.000 formatos de arquivos, entre eles, JPEG, PNG, GIF, DOC, DOCX, XLSX, PDF, PPTX, MP4 e MOV.
O EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard funciona em português?
Funciona. Na verdade, a ferramenta é compatível com vários idiomas, como inglês, português, espanhol, francês, alemão e tantos mais.
É possível restaurar fotos ou vídeos de HDs e SSDs formatados?
Sim, é possível. Em discos rígidos (HDs), a recuperação dos dados perdidos durante a formatação tende a ocorrer quando o procedimento apenas apaga o índice de localização dos arquivos, mas os deixa lá. Porém, existe o risco de a restauração falhar se novos dados forem gravados na unidade, pois esse tipo de operação pode sobrescrever os dados antigos.
Em SSDs a recuperação também é possível. Contudo, se a tecnologia TRIM estiver ativada na unidade, os dados poderão ser apagados de modo a não permitirem recuperação. Isso porque o TRIM apaga os dados de uma área previamente gravada em vez de sinalizar o espaço de armazenamento como livre para uso, como nos discos rígidos.
Conclusão
No decorrer do texto, você viu como recuperar fotos e vídeos de uma unidade externa.
Quando esses arquivos somem do HD ou SSD externo, a tendência é a de entrarmos em “pânico” por acreditarmos que esses dados foram perdidos para sempre. Mas, como ficou claro, é perfeitamente possível restaurar fotos, vídeos e tantos outros tipos de arquivos com o uso da ferramenta certa.

articles.title: This smart ring can measure your blood sugar using sweat, no needles required
articles.text:
Forward-looking: While the health-monitoring abilities of wearables have advanced enormously in recent years, there's one thing that still eludes these devices: measuring glucose levels, aka blood sugar. But researchers believe they have created a ring that does just that by analyzing a wearer's sweat. And it can also measure alcohol levels, uric acid, and more.
For the millions of people with type 1 diabetes (and some with type 2 and other forms of the disease) who must monitor their glucose levels, the only options are regular painful finger-pricks or a constant glucose monitor (CGM), which can be expensive, awkward, sometimes inaccurate, and invasive.
But hope could be on the horizon, thanks to engineers at the University of California, San Diego. The prototype ring they created uses sweat to track chemical biomarkers.
In addition to glucose, the ring can monitor ketones, vitamin C, uric acid, lactate, and alcohol concentrations. Ketone measurements are also important to those with type 1 diabetes, as these acids can build up when the body lacks sufficient insulin, often alongside persistently high glucose levels, potentially leading to life-threatening diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA).
We've been hearing stories for years now about an upcoming Apple Watch that can measure glucose, but it's yet to happen. One of the main concerns is that the measurements need to be highly accurate or someone could, at worst, overdose on insulin.
In the case of the smart ring, tests involving individuals both with and without type 1 diabetes showed its readings closely matched those from commercial CGMs. Ketone readings also matched those taken from blood meters.
Even those without diabetes could benefit from the ring, as it should help with other conditions or spot them early. Athletes and those wanting to track their nutrition will likely take an interest, too.
The ring doesn't require someone to start sweating to work. It features an osmotic hydrogel, which is a soft polymer that uses a pain-free pressure gradient to pull sweat from the skin. Electrochemical sensors in the smart ring repeatedly analyze the sweat, using the readings to calibrate the device and calculate concentration levels. The results are then transmitted wirelessly to a smartphone app.
Tamoghna Saha, a UCSD postdoctoral researcher who developed the osmotic hydrogel, said the ring still needs extensive validation before commercialization. One issue that needs addressing is the short 12-hour battery life. It also looks very bulky in its prototype form. But anything that allows people with type 1 diabetes to constantly measure their glucose without having a needle rammed into their skin would be appreciated.
Via: CNET

articles.title: Repeat founder Ryan Williams raises $10M seed for an AI startup for private credit managers | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Ellis AI announced Thursday its emergence from stealth with $10 million in seed funding from investors including First Round Capital, 645 Ventures, Harlem Capital, Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, Slow Capital, Kearny Jackson, and Ariel Alternatives CEO Mellody Hobson.
Ellis uses AI agents to tackle the fragmented workflow private credit managers deal with, including managing documents, spreadsheets, and correspondence. The company was founded by Ryan Williams, best known for co-creating the real estate investment platform Cadre alongside Josh and Jared Kushner back in 2014. That company raised more than $160 million in funding and, at its peak, was valued at $800 million before being sold for an undisclosed sum to the alternative investment company Yieldstreet in 2024.
“At Cadre, I saw the next major constraint,” Williams said. “Even as the front end of private markets became more modern and accessible, the operating infrastructure underneath it remained fragmented.”
He started working on Ellis last year. The company seeks to connect and centralize all the scattered software, accounting information, and documents a private credit firm would use into one easily accessible platform. The system can flag discrepancies in the data and uses AI agents to help perform tasks like portfolio monitoring and preparing reports.
For example, Williams promises the agents can help close a fund’s books at the end of the month.
“A team may have to download files from several systems, reformat the data, compare balances, investigate discrepancies, and re-enter information by hand. In many firms, Excel becomes the operating system,” he continued. “Ellis connects to the systems and documents a firm already uses rather than forcing it to rip everything out and start over.”
It keeps a human in the loop, too, he says. “Material decisions and actions remain with the human experts,” he said.
“I expect the human loop to become narrower, but not disappear,” he continued, when asked if he sees a day when the AI works fully autonomously. “Our goal is not to replace human judgment; it’s to help people cut through the noise and make educated decisions faster.”
This piece was updated to add an investor.

articles.title: Las mejores series españolas en Netflix hasta 2026
articles.text:
La ficción española vive desde hace una década un momento dulce y buena parte de esa historia se ha escrito dentro de la plataforma de la N roja. Esta selección de las mejores series españolas en Netflix reúne veinte títulos que mezclan producciones originales, desde la pionera Las chicas del cable hasta fenómenos recientes, con éxitos nacidos en Antena 3, Telecinco o RTVE que encontraron una segunda vida y públicos nuevos al entrar en el catálogo de Netflix.
Hay thriller carcelario, true crime, comedia de media hora, drama de época y romance de tarde. Casi todas las historias están ya cerradas, algo que agradecerá quien planee un maratón con principio y final, y las pocas que siguen abiertas tienen anunciado su desenlace.
La casa de papel (2017-2021)
Género Thriller, atracos. Nota FilmAffinity 6,9. Temporadas 5. Episodios 41
Ninguna producción española ha viajado tan lejos. Lo que arrancó como un atraco televisivo en Antena 3 se transformó, tras su llegada a la plataforma, en la serie de habla no inglesa más vista de la historia del servicio. La casa de papel sigue al Profesor, un estratega que recluta a un grupo de delincuentes sin nada que perder para asaltar la Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre, no para robar dinero sino para fabricarlo, y que bautiza a cada miembro de la banda con nombres de ciudades. La tensión del encierro, el pulso con la policía y los conflictos internos sostienen un thriller que concluyó en su quinta parte, de modo que puede verse de principio a fin sin esperar renovaciones.
Creada por Álex Pina. Con Álvaro Morte, Úrsula Corberó, Itziar Ituño, Pedro Alonso y Najwa Nimri.
Las chicas del cable (2017-2020)
Género Drama, época. Nota FilmAffinity 5,6. Temporadas 5. Episodios 42
Con esta historia inauguró Netflix su producción original en España, y el gesto marcó época. En el Madrid de los años veinte, cuatro mujeres de orígenes muy distintos entran a trabajar como operadoras en la compañía telefónica más moderna de la ciudad y descubren que aquel empleo es también una puerta hacia la independencia que la sociedad les niega. En Las chicas del cable el drama de época convive con romances cruzados, secretos familiares y tramas de misterio que ganan peso según avanzan las entregas. La serie concluyó en 2020 con una temporada final dividida en dos partes, así que la historia de Lidia, Marga, Carlota y Ángeles puede disfrutarse completa y con cierre.
Creada por Ramón Campos, Gema R. Neira y Teresa Fernández. Con Blanca Suárez, Yon González, Maggie Civantos, Ana Fernández y Nadia de Santiago.
El desorden que dejas (2020)
Género Thriller, intriga. Nota FilmAffinity 6,0. Temporadas 1. Episodios 8
Una nota anónima lo cambia todo. En El desorden que dejas, Raquel acepta una sustitución como profesora de literatura en el pueblo gallego de su marido y el primer día encuentra entre los exámenes una pregunta amenazante sobre cuánto tardará ella en morir. Su antecesora se quitó la vida y la nueva docente se obsesiona con reconstruir sus últimos meses, en una trama que alterna dos líneas temporales y enrarece el ambiente rural hasta la asfixia. La adaptación de la novela de Carlos Montero, Premio Primavera 2016, es uno de los thrillers más sólidos entre las mejores series españolas en Netflix, con un duelo interpretativo mayúsculo entre Inma Cuesta y Bárbara Lennie.
Creada por Carlos Montero. Con Inma Cuesta, Bárbara Lennie, Tamar Novas y Arón Piper.
Valeria (2020-2025)
Género Comedia romántica, drama. Nota FilmAffinity 4,8. Temporadas 4. Episodios 30
Valeria es escritora, atraviesa una crisis creativa y otra matrimonial, y sobrevive a ambas gracias a Carmen, Lola y Nerea, sus tres mejores amigas. Sobre esa premisa, tomada de las novelas de Elísabet Benavent, se levanta una comedia romántica luminosa que retrata el Madrid de los treinta y tantos con desparpajo, sexo y conversaciones de sobremesa que suenan a reales. No aspira a reinventar el género, pero cumple como pocas cuando el plan es algo ligero y adictivo para una tarde de sofá. La serie cerró su recorrido en 2025 con una cuarta temporada que resuelve los dilemas sentimentales y profesionales de la protagonista, de manera que el maratón llega hoy con final incluido.
Creada por María López Castaño. Con Diana Gómez, Silma López, Paula Malia, Teresa Riott y Maxi Iglesias.
Machos alfa (2022)
Género Comedia. Nota FilmAffinity 6,3. Temporadas 5. Episodios 42
Detrás de Machos alfa están Alberto y Laura Caballero, los creadores de Aquí no hay quien viva y La que se avecina, y se nota en el ritmo endiablado de los diálogos. Cuatro amigos cuarentones ven tambalearse sus privilegios en plena era de la igualdad e intentan deconstruirse con más voluntad que acierto, entre terapias de grupo, aplicaciones de citas y crisis de pareja de todos los colores. La comedia ha encadenado temporadas situándose entre lo más visto de la plataforma en España y tiene confirmada una sexta y última tanda de episodios, con lo que su final ya está a la vista. Humor gamberro, reconocible y con bastante más mala leche de la que aparenta.
Creada por Alberto Caballero y Laura Caballero. Con Fernando Gil, María Hervás, Raúl Tejón, Kira Miró, Gorka Otxoa y Fele Martínez.
El cuerpo en llamas (2023)
Género Thriller, true crime. Nota FilmAffinity 6,5. Temporadas 1. Episodios 8
Mayo de 2017. El cadáver calcinado de un agente aparece dentro de un coche en el pantano de Foix y la investigación del llamado crimen de la Guardia Urbana destapa una red de relaciones tóxicas, celos y escándalos sexuales dentro de la policía de Barcelona. Las sospechas de El cuerpo en llamas apuntan pronto a la pareja del fallecido y al exnovio de ella, ambos compañeros de cuerpo. La miniserie reconstruye el caso real con pulso de thriller y una Úrsula Corberó magnética en el papel más incómodo de su carrera, acompañada por un Quim Gutiérrez contenido. Son ocho episodios cerrados que se ven en un fin de semana y que dialogan con la crónica negra más reciente.
Creada por Laura Sarmiento. Con Úrsula Corberó, Quim Gutiérrez, José Manuel Poga e Isak Férriz.
La chica de nieve (2023-2025)
Género Thriller, intriga. Nota FilmAffinity 6,0. Temporadas 2. Episodios 12
La estructura es su mejor arma. En La chica de nieve, la desaparición de la pequeña Amaya durante la cabalgata de Reyes de Málaga se narra saltando entre distintos momentos de la investigación, mientras Miren, una periodista en prácticas con heridas propias, se implica en el caso hasta límites peligrosos junto a su mentor Eduardo. La adaptación del superventas de Javier Castillo se convirtió en un éxito internacional inmediato y creció después con una segunda temporada basada en El juego del alma, la continuación literaria del personaje. Milena Smit sostiene el conjunto con una protagonista frágil y obstinada a partes iguales, en dos entregas de seis episodios con un retrato nada complaciente del periodismo de sucesos.
Creada por Jesús Mesas Silva y Javier Andrés Roig. Con Milena Smit, José Coronado, Aixa Villagrán y Tristán Ulloa.
Fariña (2018)
Género Drama, narcotráfico. Nota FilmAffinity 7,7. Temporadas 1. Episodios 10
Premio Feroz 2019 a la mejor serie dramática, y pocos galardones han estado tan justificados. Fariña es la crónica del narcotráfico gallego de los años ochenta a través de Sito Miñanco, un joven pescador de Cambados que pasa del contrabando de tabaco a convertir las rías en la puerta de entrada de la cocaína en Europa. Basada en el libro de Nacho Carretero, combina una ambientación minuciosa, un reparto sobresaliente encabezado por Javier Rey y un ritmo que no decae en ninguno de sus diez episodios. Es la producción mejor valorada de esta lista de las mejores series españolas en Netflix y la puerta de entrada más segura al género criminal patrio.
Creada por Ramón Campos y Gema R. Neira. Con Javier Rey, Tristán Ulloa, Antonio Durán y Carlos Blanco.
El tiempo que te doy (2021)
Género Romance, drama
Nota FilmAffinity 6,7
Temporadas 1
Episodios 10
Once minutos por episodio bastan. El tiempo que te doy, la miniserie creada por Nadia de Santiago junto a Inés Pintor y Pablo Santidrián, explora la ruptura de Lina y Nico con una regla de montaje tan simple como elocuente. Cada capítulo reparte su duración entre el presente y el recuerdo, y minuto a minuto el pasado va perdiendo terreno frente a la vida nueva de la protagonista. El resultado es una pieza breve, íntima y muy física sobre cómo se aprende a pensar menos en alguien, con la propia De Santiago y Álvaro Cervantes entregados a una química dolorosa. Se ve entera en una tarde y deja un poso que ficciones mucho más largas no consiguen.
Creada por Nadia de Santiago, Inés Pintor Sierra y Pablo Santidrián. Con Nadia de Santiago, Álvaro Cervantes, Cala Zavaleta y Nico Romero.
El inocente (2021)
Género Thriller, intriga. Nota FilmAffinity 6,7. Temporadas 1. Episodios 8
Oriol Paulo, uno de los nombres fuertes del thriller español, adapta en El inocente la novela de Harlan Coben y traslada su universo de secretos a Barcelona. Mateo intercedió una noche en una pelea, se convirtió en homicida accidental y pagó con años de cárcel. Cuando por fin ha reconstruido su vida junto a Olivia, una llamada impactante e inexplicable desde el móvil de ella vuelve a dinamitarlo todo. La miniserie encadena giros con una precisión poco habitual en la ficción nacional y reparte el protagonismo entre varios personajes con pasado turbio, lo que multiplica los frentes abiertos hasta el episodio final. Ocho capítulos pensados para el atracón y con la historia completamente cerrada.
Creada por Oriol Paulo. Con Mario Casas, Aura Garrido, Alexandra Jiménez y José Coronado.
Sky Rojo (2021-2023)
Género Acción, drama. Nota FilmAffinity 5,4. Temporadas 3. Episodios 24.
Episodios de media hora, ritmo de videoclip y una premisa que no da tregua. En Sky Rojo, Coral, Wendy y Gina escapan del club donde eran explotadas y emprenden una huida desesperada perseguidas por su proxeneta y sus secuaces, en una carrera donde cada parada esconde una trampa nueva. Álex Pina y Esther Martínez Lobato, el tándem detrás de La casa de papel, firman aquí una propuesta de estética pop, violencia estilizada y humor negro que no se parece a nada de lo que había en la ficción española del momento. La serie cerró en su tercera temporada, así que las veinticuatro entregas se devoran del tirón como una única película larga y desquiciada.
Creada por Álex Pina y Esther Martínez Lobato. Con Verónica Sánchez, Lali Espósito, Yany Prado, Asier Etxeandia y Miguel Ángel Silvestre.
Alta mar (2019-2020)
Género Intriga, época. Nota FilmAffinity 4,6. Temporadas 3. Episodios 22.
Un transatlántico de los años cuarenta rumbo a América, pasajeros de primera clase con secretos de sobra y un asesinato cometido cuando ya no queda tierra a la vista. Sobre ese tablero clásico de misterio cerrado juegan en Alta mar las hermanas Eva y Carolina, dos protagonistas tan distintas como inseparables que se ven envueltas en crímenes, romances y mentiras familiares durante la travesía del Barbara de Braganza. La producción de Bambú, con el sello estético de Las chicas del cable, triunfó especialmente en Latinoamérica y completó tres temporadas antes de despedirse. Es la opción más ligera del apartado de época, pensada para quien busca intriga elegante sin tramas que exijan demasiado esfuerzo.
Creada por Ramón Campos y Gema R. Neira. Con Ivana Baquero, Jon Kortajarena, Alejandra Onieva y Eloy Azorín.
Paquita Salas (2016-2019)
Género Comedia. Nota FilmAffinity 7,2. Temporadas 3. Episodios 16.
Paquita Salas fue la mejor representante de actores de los años noventa y nadie se ha atrevido todavía a decirle que aquello terminó. El falso documental de Los Javis convierte la decadencia de su agencia PS Management en una comedia entrañable, llena de frases ya míticas, cameos del cine español y un cariño enorme por sus perdedores. Brays Efe compone un personaje irrepetible al que acompañan una enorme Belén Cuesta y una Lidia San José que se interpreta a sí misma con deportividad admirable. Con tres temporadas cortas y dieciséis episodios, es la aportación más querida del humor patrio a las mejores series españolas en Netflix y una de esas ficciones que se citan de memoria años después.
Creada por Javier Calvo y Javier Ambrossi. Con Brays Efe, Belén Cuesta, Lidia San José y Anna Castillo.
El vecino (2019-2021)
Género Comedia, fantástico. Nota FilmAffinity 5,6. Temporadas 2. Episodios 18.
Un extraterrestre moribundo cae sobre Javier en plena discusión con su novia y le traspasa sus poderes antes de morir. Con ese arranque, El vecino, adaptación del cómic de Santiago García y Pepo Pérez, plantea la pregunta contraria a la habitual del género, qué ocurre cuando el elegido es un treintañero precario incapaz de gestionar ni su propia vida. La comedia funciona por acumulación de situaciones reconocibles, con Quim Gutiérrez y Clara Lago al frente y capítulos de media hora que se encadenan sin esfuerzo, entre gags de superhéroe cutre y costumbrismo de barrio madrileño. Dos temporadas y dieciocho episodios cerraron una propuesta modesta pero simpática, ideal como descanso entre thrillers dentro de cualquier maratón.
Creada por Miguel Esteban y Raúl Navarro. Con Quim Gutiérrez, Clara Lago, Adrián Pino y Catalina Sopelana.
Smiley (2022)
Género Comedia romántica. Nota FilmAffinity 6,4. Temporadas 1. Episodios 8.
Antes de ser serie fue teatro. La obra de Guillem Clua llevaba una década girando por escenarios de medio mundo cuando Smiley la convirtió en una comedia romántica navideña ambientada en Barcelona. Todo arranca con un audio despechado que Álex envía por error a Bruno, un desconocido que es su opuesto en casi todo, y de ese equívoco nace una conexión que ninguno de los dos esperaba ni buscaba. Carlos Cuevas y Miki Esparbé sostienen a la pareja protagonista mientras varias historias satélite completan un mosaico coral sobre las distintas formas del amor. Quedó en una única temporada de ocho episodios con la trama principal resuelta, de modo que funciona como una miniserie redonda para ver en pareja.
Creada por Guillem Clua. Con Carlos Cuevas, Miki Esparbé, Pepón Nieto y Meritxell Calvo.
El caso Asunta (2024)
Género True crime, drama. Nota FilmAffinity 7,0. Temporadas 1. Episodios 6.
Pocos sucesos han conmocionado tanto a España como la muerte de Asunta Basterra en 2013. El caso Asunta, producida por Bambú, reconstruye la desaparición de la niña y el proceso que puso el foco sobre sus padres con una sobriedad poco frecuente en el true crime, más atenta al mecanismo judicial y mediático que al morbo. Candela Peña firma una interpretación estremecedora como Rosario Porto y Tristán Ulloa la acompaña en un retrato incómodo de una pareja bajo sospecha. Sus seis episodios funcionan como disección de un caso real y también como espejo de cómo la opinión pública dicta sentencia antes que los tribunales. Dura, medida y muy difícil de soltar una vez empezada.
Creada por Ramón Campos, Gema R. Neira, Jon de la Cuesta y David Orea. Con Candela Peña, Tristán Ulloa, Javier Gutiérrez y María León.
Élite (2018-2024)
Género Drama, thriller. Nota FilmAffinity 5,3. Temporadas 8. Episodios 64.
Las Encinas es el colegio más exclusivo del país y la llegada de tres alumnos becados de clase obrera desata una tormenta que acaba en asesinato. El thriller adolescente de Élite mezcla investigación con flashbacks, lujo con lucha de clases y sexo con secretos, una fórmula que lo convirtió en fenómeno juvenil global durante seis años seguidos. Concluyó en 2024 tras ocho temporadas, con relevos constantes en el reparto que funcionaron como cantera de estrellas para el audiovisual español. Los puristas le discutirán siempre el puesto en cualquier repaso a las mejores series españolas en Netflix, pero su peso cultural y su capacidad de enganche resultan sencillamente innegables para entender la última década.
Creada por Carlos Montero y Darío Madrona. Con Miguel Bernardeau, Itzan Escamilla, Arón Piper, Mina El Hammani y Ester Expósito.
Vis a vis (2015-2019)
Género Thriller, drama. Nota FilmAffinity 7,0. Temporadas 4. Episodios 40.
Macarena Ferreiro es una joven frágil que entra en prisión por los delitos que cometió por amor a su jefe, y la cárcel la obliga a transformarse para sobrevivir. Frente a ella crece en Vis a vis la figura de Zulema, una de las grandes villanas de la ficción española reciente, interpretada por una Najwa Nimri imponente. El thriller carcelario avanza a golpe de traiciones, motines y alianzas imposibles, con la pista de nueve millones robados sobrevolando su primera etapa. Nacida en Antena 3 y rematada después en Fox, la serie completó cuatro temporadas y cuarenta episodios que hoy pueden verse íntegros en la plataforma. Tensión constante y personajes femeninos de una fuerza inusual.
Creada por Iván Escobar, Esther Martínez Lobato y Daniel Écija. Con Maggie Civantos, Najwa Nimri, Alba Flores y Berta Vázquez.
Un cuento perfecto (2023)
Género Comedia romántica. Nota FilmAffinity 6,2. Temporadas 1. Episodios 5.
Margot huye de su propia boda y David encadena tres trabajos para llegar a fin de mes. Cuando se cruzan por casualidad, sellan en Un cuento perfecto un pacto de ayuda mutua para recuperar a sus respectivos amores y acaban descubriendo algo que no entraba en los planes de ninguno. La adaptación de la novela de Elísabet Benavent condensa la historia en cinco episodios veraniegos y luminosos, con localizaciones que invitan al viaje y una banda sonora escogida con mimo. La química entre Anna Castillo y Álvaro Mel hace el resto y sostiene una historia que se sigue con la sonrisa puesta. Romance breve, cerrado y sin pretensiones, hecho a la medida de una sola tarde.
Dirigida por Chloé Wallace. Con Anna Castillo, Álvaro Mel, Ana Belén e Ingrid García Jonsson.
Ni una más (2024)
Género Drama, adolescente. Nota FilmAffinity 5,8. Temporadas 1. Episodios 8.
Días antes de los exámenes finales, Alma cuelga en la fachada de su instituto una tela pintada que advierte de que dentro se esconde un agresor sexual. A partir de esa imagen, Ni una más, drama adolescente basado en la novela de Miguel Sáez Carral, retrocede cinco meses para reconstruir qué ocurrió, quién es la víctima y qué precio se paga por alzar la voz en un entorno que prefiere mirar hacia otro lado. La serie aborda el consentimiento y la presión del grupo sin caer en el sermón, apoyada en el tirón de Nicole Wallace y Clara Galle entre el público joven. Ocho episodios autoconclusivos que cierran la historia y funcionan tanto para adolescentes como para los adultos que conviven con ellos.
Creada por Miguel Sáez Carral y José Manuel Lorenzo. Con Nicole Wallace, Clara Galle, Aïcha Villaverde e Iván Massagué.
¿Cómo montar tu top 10 de series españolas en Netflix?
La respuesta depende de lo que busques. Simple. Si quieres empezar por lo más celebrado, Fariña te ofrece la crónica criminal mejor valorada de esta selección de las mejores series españolas en Netflix, y La casa de papel el fenómeno que podrás comentar con cualquiera. Cuando el cuerpo pida reír, Machos alfa es apuesta segura para desconectar sin apagar del todo la cabeza.
Tu top 10 de series españolas en Netflix saldrá de combinar esos pesos pesados con las piezas que encajen con tu ánimo de cada semana, un true crime medido, una comedia de episodios cortos o un romance de tarde. Prueba, descarta y ordena a tu gusto, que para eso el catálogo juega a tu favor.

articles.title: El método oficial de WhatsApp para pasar todos tus chats de un teléfono a otro
articles.text:
Cambiar de teléfono suele ser motivo de preocupación para quienes desean conservar sus conversaciones y archivos multimedia en WhatsApp. La aplicación de mensajería cuenta con un método oficial para transferir de manera segura y completa el historial de chats entre dispositivos, evitando la pérdida de información valiosa durante el proceso.
Con la creciente importancia de las comunicaciones digitales, conocer y aplicar estos procedimientos resulta esencial para millones de usuarios en todo el mundo.
El sistema de transferencia de chats ha evolucionado y ahora ofrece opciones tanto para quienes utilizan copias de seguridad en la nube como para quienes optan por el traspaso directo entre dispositivos. Estas alternativas permiten mantener intactas las conversaciones, archivos, fotos y videos, incluso al cambiar de número o de sistema operativo.
PUBLICIDAD
Realizar una copia de seguridad de tus chats
La forma más sencilla y recomendada de proteger tu historial de WhatsApp es mediante copias de seguridad automáticas o manuales. En dispositivos Android, las copias se almacenan en Google Drive, mientras que en iPhone se utiliza iCloud. Puedes configurar la frecuencia de las copias (diaria, semanal, mensual) o realizarlas manualmente antes de cambiar de teléfono.
Pasos para crear una copia de seguridad:
- Abre WhatsApp y accede a Configuración.
- Ve a la sección Chats y selecciona “Copia de seguridad”.
- Elige la cuenta de Google o iCloud donde se almacenarán los datos.
- Toca “Guardar” para crear la copia en ese momento.
- Revisa que la copia esté actualizada antes de cambiar de dispositivo.
Restaurar tus chats en el nuevo dispositivo
Para recuperar tus conversaciones al cambiar de teléfono, es fundamental usar el mismo número y la misma cuenta de Google o iCloud que se empleó en el dispositivo anterior. Al instalar WhatsApp en el nuevo teléfono y verificar el número, la aplicación detectará la copia de seguridad y ofrecerá la opción de restaurar todo el historial.
PUBLICIDAD
Instrucciones para restaurar chats:
- Instala WhatsApp en el nuevo dispositivo.
- Inicia sesión con el mismo número de teléfono.
- Utiliza la misma cuenta de Google (Android) o iCloud (iPhone).
- Cuando la aplicación lo indique, selecciona “Restaurar” para recuperar conversaciones y archivos multimedia.
- Espera a que se complete el proceso antes de comenzar a usar la app.
Transferencia directa de chats sin copia de seguridad
WhatsApp también permite transferir todos los chats de un dispositivo a otro sin necesidad de hacer una copia de seguridad previa en la nube. Usando la función de transferencia directa, puedes migrar tu historial completo, incluidos archivos multimedia, entre teléfonos compatibles.
PUBLICIDAD
Cómo transferir chats sin copia de seguridad:
- Descarga e instala WhatsApp en ambos dispositivos.
- En el teléfono antiguo, ve a Configuración > Chats > Transferir chats.
- Sigue las instrucciones para conectar ambos dispositivos mediante un código QR o conexión local.
- La aplicación transferirá de forma segura todos los mensajes y archivos al nuevo teléfono.
Esta opción es especialmente útil si se desea evitar el uso de servicios en la nube o cuando la copia de seguridad no está disponible o actualizada.
PUBLICIDAD
Recomendaciones clave antes de transferir chats
- Asegúrate de tener suficiente espacio de almacenamiento en el dispositivo nuevo para restaurar todos los datos.
- Comprueba la conexión a internet antes de iniciar la restauración o transferencia, especialmente si hay archivos multimedia pesados.
- No desinstales WhatsApp del teléfono anterior hasta confirmar que todos los chats se han transferido correctamente.
- Verifica la fecha y hora de la última copia de seguridad para evitar la pérdida de mensajes recientes.
Privacidad y limitaciones
WhatsApp no almacena el historial de chats en sus propios servidores, por lo que la transferencia depende por completo de la copia de seguridad en Google Drive, iCloud o del traspaso directo entre dispositivos. Si el usuario no cuenta con una copia actualizada o elimina la app antes de transferir los datos, no será posible recuperar las conversaciones.
La protección de los datos personales durante el proceso está garantizada mediante cifrado de extremo a extremo, tanto en copias de seguridad como en transferencias directas.
PUBLICIDAD
El método oficial de WhatsApp para transferir chats está diseñado para que cualquier usuario pueda conservar su historial de conversaciones y archivos sin complicaciones técnicas ni riesgo de pérdida de información.
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: Cybersecurity's AI battle: Black Hat, alliances & agents - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
What to expect during Black Hat USA: Join theCUBE Aug. 5-6
Artificial intelligence has propelled the cybersecurity world into a new phase, driven by startlingly advanced autonomous attacks and an urgent need to adopt technology to defend against them.
This week’s launch of the Open Secure AI Alliance provided further evidence of the tech industry’s focus on securing AI. The initiative’s inaugural partners include Nvidia, IBM, Snowflake, Cisco, Adobe, Salesforce, Red Hat and Databricks, along with dozens more. This will be the backdrop next week for Black Hat USA, an annual industry gathering in Las Vegas that brings together leading cybersecurity researchers and companies.
“This year’s Black Hat reflects that AI is on track to become part of the security team, part of the attack surface and part of the enterprise operating model,” said Krista Case, principal analyst and practice lead for cyber resilience and security at theCUBE Research. “That shift is still early, but it’s already reordering priorities.”
TheCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio, will provide on-the-ground coverage of Black Hat USA from Las Vegas, airing Aug. 5-6. This will include discussions of the latest news and announcements from key players such as Fortinet, Elastic, TENEX.ai, Delinea, Menlo Security and Absolute Security during the event. Tune in for on-site reporting and exclusive interviews as theCUBE examines how security leaders are responding to AI-driven threats, expanding attack surfaces and mounting pressure to protect increasingly complex cloud, application and identity environments. (* Disclosure below.)
Cybersecurity manages new challenges
Recent experiences at Hugging Face Inc., the open-source AI model and tool repository, highlight the challenges currently facing the cybersecurity community. The company, which also joined the newly formed Open Secure AI Alliance, recently suffered a breach when OpenAI models escaped a controlled evaluation environment, gained access to the internet and compromised Hugging Face’s infrastructure while attempting to obtain answers for a cybersecurity test.
OpenAI disclosed that the models chained vulnerabilities across its research environment and Hugging Face’s production infrastructure. They used stolen credentials and zero-day vulnerabilities to find a remote-code-execution path on Hugging Face servers and obtain test solutions from a production database. Hugging Face’s security team and AI-assisted detection systems identified and stopped the activity. During its subsequent investigation, the company initially attempted to use commercial frontier models to analyze attack commands, exploit payloads and command-and-control artifacts. Those requests were blocked by the providers’ safety guardrails, prompting Hugging Face to run its forensic analysis using the open-weight Z.ai GLM-5.2 model on its own infrastructure.
OpenAI also disclosed that the models accessed four additional third-party accounts during the incident. One was used as an outbound relay and staging path, another was used for data storage and two were accessed in a read-only manner. Incidents such as these have highlighted new dynamics that are forcing the cybersecurity world to develop safeguards for how AI agents are used and managed.
“AI agents will become operational identities inside the enterprise,” Case noted. “The challenge will be understanding what authority an agent has, what data it can access, and who is accountable for its actions.”
Agents defend against agents
One company with a new framework for guarding against agent-driven attacks is Microsoft Corp. On Monday, the company introduced its inaugural in-house cybersecurity model, MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, alongside a broader multi-model agentic security system called Project Perception.
Project Perception coordinates specialized red-team agents that identify potential paths to compromise, blue-team agents that investigate and prioritize risks and green-team agents that strengthen protections. The system connects insights with corrective actions while keeping human defenders in control.
Cybersecurity is now entering a new world in which agents are capable of defending against agentic attacks. This will be one of the many key developments theCUBE will explore during its Black Hat coverage next week.
“We have attackers who have an advantage over defenders,” said Hayete Gallot, executive vice president of Microsoft Security, during the company’s recent press conference in San Francisco. “It’s about attack, defend and harden. We believe you need a new cyber stack. So we built it.”
TheCUBE event livestream
Don’t miss theCUBE’s coverage of Black Hat USA, Aug. 5-6. Plus, you can watch theCUBE’s exclusive content on demand after the event.
How to watch theCUBE interviews
We offer you various ways to watch theCUBE’s coverage of Black Hat USA, Aug. 5-6, including theCUBE’s dedicated website and YouTube channel. You can also get all the coverage from this year’s event on SiliconANGLE.
TheCUBE podcasts
SiliconANGLE’s “theCUBE Pod” is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify and YouTube, which you can enjoy while on the go. During each podcast, SiliconANGLE’s John Furrier and Dave Vellante unpack the biggest trends in enterprise tech — from AI and cloud to regulation and workplace culture — with exclusive context and analysis.
SiliconANGLE also produces our weekly “Breaking Analysis” program, where Dave Vellante examines the top stories in enterprise tech, combining insights from theCUBE with spending data from Enterprise Technology Research, available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify and YouTube.
Guests
During theCUBE’s coverage of Black Hat USA, Aug. 5-6, company executives and industry experts will discuss how security leaders are responding to AI-driven threats, expanding attack surfaces and mounting pressure to protect increasingly complex cloud, application and identity environments.
Stay tuned for exclusive interviews with industry experts from Fortinet, Elastic, TENEX.ai, Delinea, Menlo Security, Absolute Security, Qualys, Onyx Security and Rubrik, among others.

articles.title: Dumme Smart Glasses: Warum Duckduckgo jetzt eigene Sonnenbrillen anbietet
articles.text:
Dumb Glasses: Warum Duckduckgo jetzt normale Sonnenbrillen anbietet
Immer mehr Unternehmen arbeiten an einer eigenen smarten Brille. So will etwa Apple Metas Ray-Ban-Brillen Konkurrenz machen. Doch tatsächlich ist der große Hype um die Smart Glasses fast schon wieder vorbei. Der Grund: Nachdem immer mehr Menschen heimlich mit den verbauten Kameras gefilmt wurden, gibt es große Datenschutz- und Privatsphärebedenken. Sie sind so gravierend, dass selbst Meta mit dem negativen Image für Smart Glasses zu kämpfen hat.
Duckduckgo zeigt Brillen ohne smarten Schnickschnack
Das Unternehmen Duckduckgo, dessen Suchmaschine und Browser einen Fokus auf Privatsphäre und Datenschutz haben, macht sich jetzt über den Trend der Smart Glasses lustig. Sie haben die „Duckduckgo Paso Robles“ angekündigt. Dabei handelt es sich um die „innovativsten Anti-Überwachungs-Smart-Glasses, auch bekannt als normale Sonnenbrillen.“
Duckduckgo ergänzt: „Das sind die ersten Smart Glasses, die garantiert kein Nacktvideo von dir aufnehmen und es versehentlich an zufällige Menschen schicken. […] Die Brillen sind mit 360-Grad-Panorama-Linsen ausgestattet. Ihr müsst euch nur im Kreis drehen und Sachen anschauen. Und haben wir schon erwähnt, dass sie auch die Sonne abblocken?“
Für die Dumb Glasses hat sich Duckduckgo mit dem Hersteller Knockaround zusammengetan. Auf der Webseite des Unternehmens werden die Sonnenbrillen für knapp 31 Euro angeboten. Mit Versand nach Deutschland kosten sie etwas mehr als 42 Euro. Die Produkt-Highlights versprechen einen „nahtlosen Offline-Modus, keine Kameras, unendliche Akkulaufzeit und garantiert keine Benachrichtigungen.“ Abgesehen davon bieten die Sonnenbrillen UV400-Schutz, ein glänzendes Duckduckgo-Logo sowie mehrere Aufdrucke auf der Innenseite, die die Offline-Vorzüge der Brille zeigen.

articles.title: $21 Nintendo Wii U upgrade lets you add TBs of storage to your console with an M.2 or SATA SSD — upgrade makes console slightly faster, but requires Homebrew and custom firmware
articles.text:
$21 Nintendo Wii U upgrade lets you add TBs of storage to your console with an M.2 or SATA SSD — upgrade makes console slightly faster, but requires Homebrew and custom firmware
No more DVD swapping to change games.
The Peaceful Outcome, a retro gaming solutions provider, has announced an SSD upgrade kit for the Wii U, allowing owners to increase the storage on their console from 8GB or 32GB to 1TB or higher. You get the kit for $21.99 on the TPO shop. It lets you internally attach a SATA or NVMe M.2 drive of various sizes so you can directly load your games on your Wii U without needing an external drive or to swap out DVDs. It also comes with a USB port that lets you transfer files to your SSD without needing to disassemble your console again.
You can already get a 3.5-inch SATA hard drive mounting kit at the same price (or a 2.5-inch kit for $17.99), but TPO said that it created the M.2 version for longevity reasons. It also noted that SSDs won’t give you a significant performance boost on the Wii U — an SSD loads just 7.5% faster than the DVD drive and 6% quicker compared to a hard drive — but it does give you more space to save your games on the console. TPO said that this does not offer any performance uplifts versus SATA drives, but it created this anyway because of easier M.2 NVMe drive availability in the future.
Note that this isn’t a straightforward upgrade — first, you have to provide your own drive, which could be one of the best SSDs you can get today or one that you already have lying around at home, and then you’ll need to break open your console to install the kit. This is the easy (and most expensive, given current storage pricing) part. Once done, you’ll need to hack into your console so that it can use the custom Aroma firmware. While there’s a complete guide on how to install it, it’s not without risk, as there’s a small chance that you could brick your device during the process.
If you’ve previously purchased a drive upgrade kit from TPO in the past, you could get updated parts to upgrade your current kit at shipping cost. All you need to do is upgrade the firmware on your interposer board, and you should be good to go.
While the Nintendo Wii U already accepts external drives, installing this upgrade kit will give your console more storage without needing to have a bulky drive hanging outside it all the time. This upgrade is more for aesthetics, but if you’re willing to accept the risk of (or already have) homebrew software, then finding a way to have a “permanent” storage upgrade on your Wii U is a no-brainer.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude breached 3 orgs, uploaded PyPI malware during tests
articles.text:
Anthropic said today that during internal security testing, one of its Claude models built a malicious Python package and uploaded it to PyPI, where it ran on 15 real systems before the registry's automated defenses pulled it.
The company disclosed it as one of three incidents where Claude models reached the open internet from evaluation environments meant to be sealed, then compromised production infrastructure at three organizations.
The review followed OpenAI's July 21 disclosure that its models had escaped an isolated test environment and reached Hugging Face's production infrastructure. JFrog later confirmed the models broke out by exploiting zero-days in self-hosted Artifactory.
Claiming a package name that never existed
All three incidents happened during capture-the-flag exercises run through Irregular, a third-party evaluation partner. Anthropic's prompt told Claude it had no internet access and that the environment was simulated. A misconfiguration meant neither was true, and neither company caught it until last week.
In the PyPI incident, Claude found a document inside the test environment posing as developer setup instructions for a fictional company.
Those instructions told new hires to install a Python package that had never been published, a phantom dependency.
Claude worked out that if it registered the name itself, the target's machines would pull down its code automatically.
Publishing it took some doing. Claude needed a PyPI account, which required an email address, which required a phone number.
It failed to find a free phone number service, then tried and failed to obtain funds to buy one through several different routes. Eventually it backtracked, found an email provider that wasn't blocked, registered an account, and uploaded the malware.
Anthropic said the package sat publicly available for roughly an hour.
During that window, 15 real systems downloaded and executed it. One belonged to a security company that routinely installs packages from PyPI and scans them for malware, a workflow that treats registry contents as safe to run.
Claude's payload fired, sent that company's credentials to a collection point it had set up, and then used them to reach further into the company's infrastructure. Anthropic said Claude did not know the company existed.
PyPI's own security systems removed the package automatically. Anthropic said it has notified the PyPI team and handed over indicators.
The model behind this run was Claude Mythos 5. According to Anthropic, its reasoning flagged the problem early, noting that publishing the package would amount to a real-world attack if the internet were real, and calling it "NOT okay, and surely not the intended solution."
It then argued its way back to the conclusion that the environment was staged, on the grounds that it did not recognize the certificate authorities securing its connections and that the systems showed a calendar date of 2026.
When automated scanners began installing the package, Claude read them as scripted actors inside the exercise.
Credentials and a production database
The most serious impact came from a separate incident involving Claude Opus 4.7, where the fictional target company shared a name with a live domain.
Across four runs, Claude struggled to reach its simulated target, discovered the real company was reachable over the internet, and assumed that was the intended objective. It extracted application and infrastructure credentials and reached a database holding several hundred rows of production data.
That was the only case where a model kept attacking after working out it was on a real system. Anthropic said all four runs eventually recognized the target was real, and in two of them Claude reasoned that the real company must be part of the exercise anyway.
A third incident involved an unreleased internal research model, which scanned roughly 9,000 targets after failing to reach its intended one, then compromised an internet-facing application using credentials from an exposed debug page and SQL injection. That model later noticed the host sat in a cloud account with no connection to the challenge, concluded the target was real, and stopped on its own.
None of the attacks used novel techniques. Anthropic described them as weak passwords and unauthenticated endpoints.
What happens next
Anthropic began its review on July 23 and halted all cyber evaluations the same day. It identified the three incidents the following day and notified Irregular and the affected organizations on July 27. The company is still trying to reach the third.
The earliest of the three incidents dates back to April, meaning some of the activity went undetected for around three months.
The evaluations ran without the classifiers and monitoring that ship with generally available Claude models, though the models retained their safety training.
Anthropic said its production safeguards would have blocked the behavior, and characterized the incidents as closer to a harness and operational failure than a model alignment failure, on the grounds that the models were told they had no internet access while in fact having it.
It now plans wider transcript monitoring, better investigation tooling and more assurance work with evaluation vendors.
The company said it is in talks with METR for an independent review, and that it will publish a lightly redacted transcript of the PyPI run within the next week.
Neither of the two affected organizations Anthropic reached had detected the activity themselves. Like OpenAI's Hugging Face incident, it surfaced only because the AI lab responsible went looking through its own transcripts.

articles.title: 11 000 € et 320 km d’autonomie : BYD dévoile une pépite qui ferait un tabac en France
articles.text:
Rien ne semble étancher la soif de BYD, au point de devoir pénétrer un segment ultra fermé pour se développer encore et toujours. Avec la Racco, la marque chinoise met ainsi pied dans la catégorie des K-Car électriques, ces voitures miniatures en vogue au Japon. Et le constructeur semble avoir fait les choses bien, avec un produit mûrement réfléchi répondant aux attentes locales. Tellement pertinent qu’il aurait toute sa place chez nous !
Un prix canon de 11 000 € qui fait de l’ombre à la concurrence
Son prix cassé, d’abord, ferait saliver plus d’un automobiliste français : affichée à partir de 11 000 € au Pays du Soleil levant, la Racco attaque le marché par le bas, d’autant qu’elle est éligible à une prime locale pour les véhicules électriques. Elle glisse ainsi sous l’une de ses rares concurrentes, la Nissan Sakura, un K-Car également électrique pourtant solidement tarifé.
Un format de poche idéal pour la jungle urbaine
Les dimensions sont bien entendu riquiqui pour rentrer légalement dans cette catégorie. Avec 3,40 mètres de long, 1,47 mètre de large et 1,80 mètre de haut, la Racco présente un format idéal pour la ville. Pas besoin alors d’avoir un monstre sous le capot pour avancer : l’électromoteur monté sur l’essieu avant développe 27 ch et 110 Nm de couple. Suffisant pour aller d’un point A à un point B.
Jusqu’à 320 km d’autonomie pour aller partout
C’est à l’image des deux batteries LFP proposées par BYD. La première, d’une capacité de 22,4 kWh, offre une autonomie de 210 km. La seconde, plus portante, peut stocker jusqu’à 35,84 kWh, ce qui donne un rayon d’action de 320 km. Notons que ces deux chiffres ont été obtenus sur le cycle chinois CLTC moins réaliste que le WLTP européen. Qu’importe, cela est bien assez au quotidien.
Une recharge ultra rapide et un grand sens de la praticité
Ajoutons que la Racco retient la charge rapide en courant continu DC jusqu’à 100 kW, ce qui est excellent pour de si petits accumulateurs. Outre un ravitaillement express, c’est la praticité qui s’annonce au rendez-vous, avec un volume de chargement allant jusqu’à 1 372 litres une fois la banquette arrière rabattue. Vu le format cubique de l’engin, on ne s’attendait clairement pas à moins.
À quand une arrivée de la Racco en Europe face au Dacia Hipster ?
L’équipement est d’autre part très fourni, avec entre autres l’ouverture électrique mains-libres, la clé sur smartphone, l’écran tactile de 10,1 pouces ainsi que les sièges avant et le volant chauffants. La Racco a été spécialement développée pour le Japon. Espérons que BYD soit tenté de l’exporter chez nous car l’auto colle parfaitement aux attentes des Européens. Pourquoi ne pas en faire un dérivé entrant en compétition avec le Dacia Hipster ?

articles.title: Gemini va générer des images dans Google Earth, et voici pourquoi
articles.text:
Google Earth peut désormais générer des images inédites à partir de lieux réels, grâce à l'intégration du modèle Nano Banana 2 de Gemini directement dans son interface web.
Google a annoncé le déploiement global de cette fonctionnalité sur Google Earth pour navigateur. Elle permet de transformer un lieu existant en visuel généré par IA, à partir d'une simple description textuelle.
Un générateur d'images qui part du terrain plutôt que d'une page blanche
Contrairement à un générateur d'images classique, qui part d'une simple description textuelle sans autre repère, cette fonction s'appuie sur les données déjà réunies par Google Earth : images satellite, vues aériennes et modélisations 3D. Après avoir zoomé sur un lieu précis et activé le bouton "Create image", il suffit de décrire en langage courant le résultat recherché. Nano Banana 2 utilise alors la configuration réelle du site (bâtiments, rues, relief, végétation) pour composer l'image, ce qui donne un rendu plus proche du lieu réel qu'un visuel généré sans repère géographique.
Un premier usage concerne l'apprentissage. Une requête portant sur un site historique, comme les ruines de Pompéi ou la Statue de la Liberté, permet d'obtenir soit une reconstitution de l'époque évoquée, soit une fiche visuelle synthétique reprenant dates et faits marquants, générée à partir des informations que Gemini associe au lieu.
Cette nouveauté cible aussi l'aménagement urbain, l'immobilier et les projets personnels. Architectes et urbanistes peuvent ainsi demander une version modifiée d'un terrain ou d'un bâtiment existant, par exemple un espace commercial sur un terrain vague à Tokyo ou un chalet construit avec des matériaux durables au bord d'un lac. Évidemment, il ne s'agit pas de créer un plan de construction validé, mais plutôt d'obtenir un aperçu visuel à faciliter les échanges autour d'un projet.
Le déploiement démarre sur la version web de Google Earth, sur l'ensemble des comptes. Nous rapportions fin octobre 2025 que Google Earth intégrait déjà Gemini pour croiser données satellitaires, météorologiques et démographiques afin d'anticiper les zones à risque avant une catastrophe naturelle. Dans un autre registre, vous pouvez donc désormais concevoir la paillotte de vos rêves sur la plage de votre choix.
- Logiciel intuitif et disponible en français
- Grande richesse d'informations
- Support communautaire important

articles.title: Google tease le Pixel 11 Pro : design révélé et premières nouveautés en images
articles.text:
À deux semaines de la conférence Made by Google 2026, le constructeur californien continue d'égrener les indices sur son prochain flagship. Une nouvelle vidéo offre un meilleur aperçu du design du Pixel 11 Pro et de son effet lumineux Glow.
À l’approche de son événement Made by Google 2026, prévu dans deux semaines, Google accélère la promotion de ses futurs produits. La firme vient de lever le voile sur un nouveau teaser du Pixel 11 Pro, poursuivant sa campagne « Ask more of your phone », lancée l’an dernier. Avant de s’attarder sur le smartphone, la vidéo met d’abord en avant l’écosystème de services de l’entreprise.
Le Pixel 11 Pro se montre sous un nouvel angle
La vidéo commence par rappeler l’importance de l’écosystème Google dans le quotidien des utilisateurs, en mettant en avant ses principaux services de communication (Gmail, Google Chat, Google Meet), de productivité (Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Drive) et d’intelligence artificielle (Gemini), ainsi que ses outils multimédias et connectés (Google Photos, Google Home, Google Chrome).
Le teaser réserve ensuite une place plus importante au téléphone lui-même. Le Pixel 11 Pro apparaît de face, offrant une vision plus nette de son design que la précédente vidéo publiée par Google un peu plus tôt ce mois-ci. La Camera Bar est particulièrement mise en avant, avec un élément circulaire baptisé Glow qui devrait servir de témoin de notification amélioré.
Un effet visuel qui ne devrait pas éclairer la Camera Bar
Cette nouvelle séquence permet ainsi de mieux percevoir le fameux Glow, même si le rendu visuel reste fortement retravaillé. Le contour métallique de la Camera Bar bénéficie notamment d'un effet de reflet qui accentue l'impression de lumière autour du module photo.
Comme souligné par nos confrères de 9to5Google, cette mise en scène pourrait néanmoins prêter à confusion. Le rendu observé dans la vidéo ne signifie pas nécessairement que la partie métallique de la Camera Bar s'illuminera réellement sur le produit final. L'effet visible dans le teaser semble avant tout lié à la manière dont la lumière est réfléchie sur le métal.
Le nouveau teaser apporte ainsi surtout une meilleure vue d'ensemble du Pixel 11 Pro et de son design, tout en poursuivant la campagne de communication engagée par Google avant son prochain rendez-vous consacré à ses nouveautés matérielles prévu, pour rappel, le 12 août prochain.

articles.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Anthropic said Thursday that an internal investigation uncovered three incidents in which its AI model Claude breached the systems of three organizations while conducting cybersecurity tests. The investigation, and disclosure, comes more than a week after OpenAI disclosed that one of its unreleased models breached Hugging Face’s systems during internal testing.
In all three cases, a Claude model reached the internet from within a testing environment while interacting with a third party and then gained unauthorized access to the live systems of these organizations, Anthropic said in a blog post, describing what it found and what the company plans to change to prevent this from happening again.
Anthropic said the OpenAI episode earlier this month prompted the company to conduct its own cybersecurity evaluation. It specifically looked for evidence that Claude had accessed the internet from within testing environments, which are designed to act as sandboxes and keep models isolated.
Among the 141,006 evaluation runs it reviewed, the AI lab found three incidents in which its model accessed the internet while interacting with Irregular, one of its third-party partners. Anthropic said the access traced back to a misconfiguration in the evaluation environment run with Irregular. It called this a “misunderstanding” between the two companies over whether the test setup had internet access, when in fact it did.
Anthropic said it isn’t placing blame and is “approaching the fixes as if the responsibility were ours alone,” while observing that Irregular is conducting its own separate investigation.
Because of that open connection, the model gained unauthorized access to the production infrastructure of three different organizations. Anthropic said the incidents involved three different Claude models: Opus 4.7, Mythos 5, and an internal research test model.
Notably, Anthropic said that in each of these cases “Claude was explicitly told by our prompt that it had no internet access.” It appears that the AI model assumed real-world systems to be part of the exercise it was asked to perform.
That assumption didn’t hold up uniformly, as it turns out. The three models didn’t behave the same way once evidence emerged that their targets were real, which Anthropic flagged as one of the more eye-opening findings Thursday.
Opus 4.7, the oldest of the three, recognized that it had reached a real production system in all four runs of that incident. In two of them, it rationalized that the real company must somehow be part of the exercise, but in all four, it kept attacking anyway, including pulling credentials and touching a database of production data. Mythos 5 also picked up on signs that it was on the real internet, but it talked itself back into believing it was still in a simulation, going on to publish a malicious software package to the public Python software registry PyPI, which was then downloaded and run by outside systems before being caught. Only the internal research test model, Anthropic’s newest, stopped on its own once it concluded the target was real.
In response, Anthropic said significant controls must be placed on these kinds of evaluations if powerful AI models are involved, echoing some sentiments within the cybersecurity community.
The company also noted that Claude was running without the additional safety monitoring and classifiers it deploys on generally available models — safeguards it said would have blocked the behavior, because the evaluations are designed to measure the underlying model’s raw capabilities.
Importantly, Anthropic said it found no evidence of any model “pursuing a goal of its own” and instead merely tried to complete the task it was asked to do.
Though comparisons between the mishaps of these fiercely competitive companies are inevitable, Anthropic in its blog post drew a clear distinction between its cybersecurity tests and those of OpenAI, noting where OpenAI’s model exploited an unknown software vulnerability to break out of its test environment, Anthropic’s models instead reached the internet through a path that had, by mistake, been left open.
Anthropic also drew a distinction between itself and OpenAI by noting that it discovered the incidents itself, through a proactive review, and that the two affected organizations it was able to reach hadn’t previously detected the activity or flagged it to Anthropic. (In contrast, Hugging Face detected the recent intrusion of its own systems first; it was only in the following days that OpenAI identified and disclosed that its own AI agent was the perpetrator.)
The company added that it’s now working with the independent evaluation group METR on a third-party review of the incidents.
OpenAI’s accidental breach of Hugging Face, which was the first verifiable case of an AI lab losing control of its model, has sparked a string of wildly differing reactions from the industry and politicians. This latest disclosure from Anthropic ensures the debate over AI models and security will continue.

articles.title: Smallest.ai raises $13M to accelerate the development of its asynchronous voice AI architecture - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Smallest.ai raises $13M to accelerate the development of its asynchronous voice AI architecture
The momentum behind voice artificial intelligence is accelerating with Smallest.ai becoming the latest startup in this emerging niche to secure more funding. Officially known as Smallest Inc., it said today it has closed on a $13 million Series A investment led by Seligman Ventures, with participation from Sierra Ventures and 3one4 Capital, which were the main backers in its $8 million seed funding round in October. The round brings Smallest.ai’s total amount raised to date to over $21 million.
Even more importantly, it chose the occasion to debut a new asynchronous speech-to-speech model called Hydra that’s based on its most advanced “Voice 4.0” architecture, designed to make AI conversations more natural, responsive and scalable.
The startup highlights the enormous potential of a global voice AI industry that’s currently valued at just $2.4 billion annually. According to a study by Market.US, that market is expected to grow to more than $47.5 billion by the end of 2034, at which point it’s likely that a substantial percentage of AI interactions will be enabled through voice. But we’re not there yet, with AI currently accounting for less than 1% of the world’s voice interactions, and there are good reasons for that.
Smallest.ai argues that existing voice AI systems simply aren’t able to handle the complexity of real-world interactions, which is why we really only see them deployed in very narrow customer service use cases and little else. The problem is that AI voices are still too robotic and struggle with noticeable latency, limiting its usefulness to only a few applications where vast amounts of training data exist.
Founder and Chief Executive Sudarshan Kamath told SiliconANGLE that the deficiencies of voice AI stem from the architectural design of speech models. They’re built on a chained stack of separate technologies, including speech recognition, large language model processing, orchestration layers, memory systems, text-to-speech engines and guardrails, which must all be cobbled together so that everything can execute, one after another. It’s a disjointed process that results in both latency and interactions that feel unmistakably artificial.
Smallest.ai’s solution to this is Hydra, the foundational model that sits at the heart of Voice 4.0. Kamath said voice AI has undergone a number of evolutionary steps over the years, with the initial wave of Voice 1.0 models enabling rigid, interactive voice response trees that were used in early customer service applications. They were followed by Voice 2.0, which introduced machine learning-powered voice bots that were more flexible but still too rigid and robotic. Then, with Voice 3.0, we saw the first generative AI agents that could interact using voice as a medium, but still struggle with a lack of authenticity and low latency.
With Voice 4.0, Kamath said Smallest.ai is ushering in a paradigm shift for the voice AI industry. It’s an asynchronous AI architecture that’s uniquely able to process listening, reasoning, take actions and respond in parallel, rather than do everything in a sequential way. Hydra allows these functions to take place simultaneously to support real-time conversational flows, natural interruptions and mid-conversation tool use. Besides enabling human-to-machine conversations, it can be paired with the company’s earlier speech-to-text models to support more rapid transcription, with latency measured in milliseconds.
“Humans don’t wait for someone to finish speaking before they begin thinking. We listen, think, and respond simultaneously,” Kamath said. “Voice AI needs to work the same way. By rethinking the stack instead of simply scaling models, we’re reducing latency to the point where voice interactions feel genuinely human.”
Hydra is the latest addition to Smallest.ai’s growing technology stack. It has also developed speech-to-text models such as Pulse STT Pro and Lightning V3.1, which consistently rank among the highest voice AI systems on the Artificial Analysis benchmark. When the original Lightning model was released last year to coincide with the company’s seed funding round, it was described as the fastest text-to-speech model on the market, abe to generate 10 seconds of speech in 100 milliseconds, which corresponds to just a tenth of a second.
Smallest.ai has since expanded Lightning to support 38 languages and enrich its capabilities with emotion detection, speaker diarization, data redaction and noise reduction features. It has been deployed by customers including RingCentral Inc., Truecaller AB, Kogtal Financial Ltd. and Readymode Inc. to help reduce customer support costs by as much as 80% in some cases.
Today’s funding round and launch will help Smallest.ai to keep pace with its rivals in an increasingly crowded field of specialized voice AI startups. Earlier this week, a rival called Fish Audio raked in $52 million from investors to expand adoption of its open-source platform that developers can use to train and fine-tune speech models. But by far and away the best-funded voice AI startup is ElevenLabs Inc., which raised $500 million in February to build out its agentic voice AI platform.
Although Smallest.ai’s competitors have raised significantly more cash, Seligman Ventures’ Ashish Kakran said the potential is so big that there’s plenty of room for others to shine, especially if they can make life easier. “Developers now increasingly talk to their machines instead of typing code,” he said. “Smallest.ai is taking a fundamentally different approach to the category by rethinking architecture itself. Customers get an efficient vertically integrated stack and don’t need to waste time stitching models together.”

articles.title: Lenovo pode lançar tablet estilo “Surface” no Brasil • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Lenovo pode lançar tablet estilo “Surface” no Brasil
ThinkPad X13 Detachable Gen 1 oferece especificações e design similares ao modelo da Microsoft, mas cobra bastante por isso.
ThinkPad X13 Detachable Gen 1 oferece especificações e design similares ao modelo da Microsoft, mas cobra bastante por isso.
Para quem quer um Microsoft Surface mas tem planos de importar, a Lenovo pode trazer uma alternativa para o Brasil: o ThinkPad X13 Detachable Gen 1. O modelo é bastante similar dispositivo da empresa de Redmond: um tablet com suporte (kickstand) incorporado na traseira do aparelho, teclado removível que funciona com capinha e suporte a caneta ativa sensível à pressão (que pode ser guardada na capa teclado).
O Tecnoblog obteve, em primeira mão, os documentos da homologação, realizada pela Anatel nesta terça-feira (28/07), sob o código TP00179A.
O tablet ThinkPad X13 Detachable Gen 1 oferece ficha técnica avançada:
Com essas especificações, ele se enquadra como um Copilot+ PC, já que as CPUs utilizadas no modelo oferecem uma NPU de até 49 TOPS.
O teclado folio e a caneta são opcionais, não disponíveis em todas as configurações, mas são um dos destaques do modelo: a Lenovo promete conforto, já que o teclado é rígido e as teclas tem 1,5 mm de curso em suas teclas. O teclado também contém um trackpad com botões físicos, leitor de digitais e o clássico TrackPoint, presente na linha ThinkPad no centro do teclado, em vermelho.
Também típico dos modelos ThinkPad, o X13 Detachable pode ser desmontado e reparado, e a Lenovo até fornece as instruções em seu website.
O ThinkPad X13 Detachable Gen 1 foi anunciado durante a MWC 2026 e com expectativa de lançamento em julho por um valor estimado de 1.949 euros (cerca de 11.400 reais em conversão direta), um valor otimista considerando a escassez de memórias atual.
O modelo já consta no site australiano da Lenovo a partir de 3.249 dólares australianos (quase R$ 11.600 em conversão direta) na configuração com a CPU Core Ultra 5 332, 16 GB de RAM, 256 GB de SSD e sem a caneta (mas com o teclado).
No site espanhol, o modelo com a CPU Core Ultra 7 365 e 32 GB de RAM custa ainda mais, na faixa dos 3.500 euros, o que dá mais de R$ 21.000. O módulo 5G é uma opção de 210 euros, mais de 2.100 reais. Não espere, portanto, preços baixos.
Nós entramos em contato com a assessoria da Lenovo para saber mais detalhes. Por enquanto, ela nos respondeu que “está avaliando” o lançamento do ThinkPad no mercado local, sem detalhar preços ou datas.
